> This is a demo website built by NorthWeb.co for the Real Estate industry.

## What this site is
Real Estate / Property is a professionally designed demo website showcasing how a real estate business can look online. It was built by NorthWeb.co (yourdomain.com) as part of their client portfolio of web design services.

## Tagline
Find your perfect property with confidence

## Description
A professional real estate website with property listings, high-resolution galleries, and instant enquiry forms.

## Industry
Real Estate

## Key Features
- Property Listings: Detailed listings with photos, floor plans, price, and amenities.
- Smart Search: Filter by location, type, price, BHK, and more to find the perfect match.
- Photo Galleries: High-resolution images and virtual tour link support.
- Agent Profiles: Verified agents with ratings, active listings, and direct contact.
- Map View: Interactive property map with neighbourhood highlights.
- Instant Enquiry: One-click call and WhatsApp buttons on every single listing.
